description: List paginated raw email events for a campaign. Defaults to deliveries; use eventType or eventTypes to include opens, clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes, sends, or delivery delays.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

end.description: Optional ISO 8601 end time. Must be used with start; max range is 90 days.

eventType.description: Optional single event type. Supported values: send, delivery, bounce, complaint, open, click, unsubscribe, delivery_delay, transport_failure. Defaults to delivery.

eventTypes.description: Optional event types to include. Supported values: send, delivery, bounce, complaint, open, click, unsubscribe, delivery_delay, transport_failure. Defaults to delivery.

includeMachineEngagement.description: If true, include machine-classified bot/scanner opens and clicks. Defaults to false, so metrics and activity are human-only.

limit.description: Events per page. Defaults to 100; maximum 500.

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.

period.description: Optional sliding time window: 1h, 24h, 7d, 30d, or 90d. Ignored when start/end are provided.

start.description: Optional ISO 8601 start time. Must be used with end; max range is 90 days.

name: list_campaign_events

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `list_campaign_events` MCP tool.

events.description: List of campaign email event records returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: One item in the returned collection.
Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
